latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of knowledge-graph-hardened skill.

- Adds atomic fact management for knowledge graph under life/areas/** using Python script.
- Allows adding and superseding facts with consistent IDs; old facts are never deleted.
- Supports regenerating entity summaries from active facts.
- Enforces strong privacy and operational guardrails to protect personal data and ensure user confirmation during changes.
